_about: LIVING WORLD: the strange skills, the titles and the legends, and what in the world's history earns them. Every rule looks only at changes made by people (world_mutations, always HUMAN) and at what other people did afterwards (player_actions such as PASSAGE_USED). New skills and rules go here; the conditions they can use are the ones living_world.py knows (see 'requires').

skills.name: Echo Step
skills.description: Jumps back to where you stood three seconds ago (at most 14 m), through your own trail.

skills.name: Shortcut Whisper
skills.description: For 12 seconds you see the world's passages and where people have walked, through walls.

skills.name: Light Thief
skills.description: Puts out the floodlights within 30 m for 8 seconds, for everyone. The lights come back by themselves.

skills.name: Pocket Passage
skills.description: Steps through the thin wall or fence in front of you to the ground behind it (up to 6 m).

skills.name: Wrong-Way Sign
skills.description: For 20 seconds the bots believe the nearest passage is closed and look for another way. People are not fooled.

skills.name: Soft Landing
skills.description: For 6 seconds you jump almost twice as high.

skills.name: Last Word
skills.description: Once every five minutes, a shot that would kill you leaves you on 1 HP and untouchable for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Shared Compass
skills.description: For 15 seconds your squad sees arrows to the places that you and your squad changed.

rules.title: The One Who Lost the Bridge
rules.reason: You destroyed the North Bridge, and other people started taking the old stair instead.

legend.name: THE DAY THE BRIDGE DISAPPEARED
legend.story: {author} brought down {object}. With the bridge gone, {others} other player(s) found the old stair instead.

rules.title: Cartographer of the Impossible
rules.reason: You opened a way that at least two other people then really walked.

rules.title: The One Who Switched Off the Night
rules.reason: You shut down the Crossroads Generator and the floodlights went dark.

legend.name: THE ONE WHO STOLE THE NIGHT
legend.story: {author} shut down {object}; the floodlights along the Foundry road went dark, and {others} other player(s) crossed it in the dark.

rules.title: Architect of Nonsense
rules.reason: In one day you changed three different passages of the world.

rules.title: Upside-Down General
rules.reason: You fortified the Crossroads: two barricades of yours stand, or you held the checkpoint for half an hour.

rules.title: Friend of Accidents
rules.reason: You broke through the Shortcut Wall, and other people took the new short way.

legend.name: THE HERO OF A SINGLE WALL
legend.story: {author} tore down {object}; {others} other player(s) have since taken the short way it opened.

rules.title: The Wrong Hero
rules.reason: You took the Crossroads checkpoint back from another player.

rules.title: Makers of the Detour
rules.reason: Together with other people you changed the way to the Foundry, and someone else used the new way.

legend.name: THE WRONG WAY WAS RIGHT
legend.story: {authors} changed the way to the Foundry between them; {others} other player(s) followed the new way.

rules.title: Saint of Short Routes
rules.reason: You rebuilt what another player had destroyed.

legend.name: THE CHECKPOINT THAT CHANGED SIDES
legend.story: {authors} took {object} from one another in turn.

rules.title: Minister of Doors
rules.reason: You opened or closed three different gates of the world.

rules.title: Keeper of Names
rules.reason: You raised the memorial at the Crossroads.
